verdict.reason: Rey Cortiço is worth a quick check for early morning — 08:00, but it is not a guaranteed session.  Treat it as a check-first call rather than a sure thing.  Wind is the main thing to watch.  The tide should let the sandbars work without overdoing it.

conversationalSummary.text: TODAY, I’d check the cams first before committing: Rey Cortiço early morning is the best available option, but Surfline looks only poor-to-fair and the wind angle isn’t doing it any favours. With the tide pushing up, you might get a punchy set on the sandbanks, but wind being cross-on and gusty means it could get messy quickly. Take a look at Surfline and MEO Beachcam and only go if it looks surprisingly clean compared to what we’re expecting.
